subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Should this grouped PR wait for exact-head native proof of Peekaboo 3.7.1, or should the Peekaboo bump be split into its own PR?
rationale: Peekaboo is exact-pinned and embedded in production bridge and computer-action paths, while the current CI lane stops before compiling or testing the broad update.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Keep the grouped update only after native build, Swift tests, and focused Peekaboo bridge/computer-action smoke pass on this head.

options.title: Split Peekaboo
options.body: Review the three narrower updates separately and validate Peekaboo's broad embedded-runtime delta in a dedicated PR.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped update only after native build, Swift tests, and focused Peekaboo bridge/computer-action smoke pass on this head.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the embedded Peekaboo ownership path introduced in their prior work.
